editionLabel: Bombyx original English US base-game rulebook
firstPlayerRule: Randomly determine the starting player. Play then proceeds clockwise.
clarifications: The rulebook does not prescribe a particular random selection method.
This answer covers the base game, not the Kraken, Leviathan, or De Profundis expansions.
